title: duranta plumieri var. normalis
intro: Duranta plumieri var. normalis, commonly known as Sky Flower or Golden Dewdrop, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Verbenaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Duranta plumieri var. normalis include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant and wound-healing activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
